sentences.text: Today, we will talk about Cuba.
Cuba is a colorful, sunny, and musical island in the Caribbean Sea.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Cuba?
Cuba is an island country in the Caribbean.
It is close to the United States, Mexico, Haiti, and Jamaica.
Cuba has beaches, mountains, and old towns.
What is the capital city of Cuba?
The capital city is Havana.
Havana is a big city with old buildings, music, and cars from the 1950s.
It is full of life and color.
Other cities in Cuba include Santiago de Cuba, Camagüen, and Cienfuegos.
How many people live in Cuba?
About 11 million people live in Cuba.
Most people live in cities and towns near the coast.
Cuban people are known for being friendly, creative, and full of spirit.
What language do people speak in Cuba?
The official language is Spanish.
Many people also speak a little English, especially in tourist areas.
Cuban Spanish is spoken with a unique accent and rhythm.
What is the weather like in Cuba?
Cuba has a tropical climate.
It is hot and humid most of the year.
There are two seasons, the dry season from November to April, the rainy season from May to October.
There is a risk of hurricanes from August to October.
What does Cuba look like?
Cuba has white sand beaches and blue water, green hills and tobacco farms, old towns with colorful houses, mountains, caves, and forests.
It is a beautiful country with rich culture and nature.
What animals live in Cuba?
Cuba has many interesting animals, hummingbirds, flamingos, and parrots.
Frogs, lizards, and insects.
Crocodiles and fish, cows, chickens, and goats on farms.
The bee hummingbird, the smallest bird in the world, lives in Cuba.
What do people eat in Cuba?
Cuban food is simple, flavorful, and made with love.
People eat rice, beans, and plantains, pork, chicken, and fish.
Casava, sweet potatoes, and vegetables.
Popular dishes, ropa vieja, shredded beef and tomato sauce, a roast con polio, chicken with rice.
Yucca con mojo, cassava with garlic sauce.
Tossed stones, fried green plantains.
Cuban sandwich, ham, cheese, and pickles, and toasted bread.
What do people drink in Cuba?
People drink coffee, strong and sweet, fruit juice like mango, guava, and pineapple, water, and soda.
Adults may drink rum, often in cocktails like mojito or daiquiri.
Cuban coffee is small but very strong.
What is life like in Cuba?
Life in Cuba is social, creative, and community -based.
People enjoy music and dancing, talking with neighbors, playing dominoes or chess, going to the beach, spending time with family.
People often meet in the street, talk, laugh, and share stories.
What are some holidays and traditions in Cuba?
National Day, January 1st.
May Day, May 1st with big parades.
Carnival with music, costumes, and dance.
Christmas with family meals.
New Year's Eve with fireworks and parties.
Cuban music styles like salsa, sun, and rumba are played at festivals.
Some fun facts about Cuba.
Cuba has classic American cars from the 1950s.
Baseball is the most popular sport.
Cigars from Cuba are famous around the world.
Ernest Hemingway, the writer, lived in Cuba for many years.
The Cuban flag is red, white, and blue with a white star.
Now you know many things about Cuba.
You know where it is, what people speak, and what they eat.
You learned about music, life, and traditions.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
